189 U.S. 474 (____)

UNITED STATES
v.
BARNETT.

No. 235.

Supreme Court of United States.

Argued with No. 236, ante, p. 471, and by the same counsel.

MR. JUSTICE HOLMES:

This is the case of an enlisted man who makes a claim similar to the above, under Rev. Stat. § 1290, as amended. He was discharged on his own application, and the order of discharge stated that he was not entitled to travel pay. The foregoing reasoning also governs this case.

Judgment reversed.
